Select drug ChEMBL ID, preferred name, MeSH ID, MeSH heading, EFO ID as indication_curie, EFO term as indication_label, and max phase for indication from molecule_dictionary joined with drug_indication. Filter for drugs with max_phase_for_ind = 4. Return all rows without deduplication. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, mesh_id, mesh_heading, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
